_doc: The library clips (issue #529; tools/blender/library_motion.py, picks in tools/blender/library_picks.json): each move's clip, where it came from, its licence, its length and whether it loops. HumanBody plays them through LibraryMotion when Settings.library_motion is on.

idle.licence: CMU: free for research and commercial use
idle.why: 77_02, standing: the trunk upright and the arms hanging (111_28 leans back with the hands clasped, 140_06 leans forward)
